payout.above_threshold: flat: views beyond 40,000 pay nothing extra
payout.cpm_note: brief says 'CPM 5.000' but the payout is fixed; informational only

limits.account_unit: each platform account separately (answered by admin 2026-10-02)
limits.max_payout_note: 2 videos x 6 platform accounts x Rp 200.000, assuming 1 account per platform

weeks.rule: a video counts only in the week it was uploaded
weeks.outside_weeks: Oct 29-31 uploads: not eligible (answered by admin 2026-10-02)

hashtags.rule: exactly these, in this order, first in the caption; nothing before them

content.source: any IC (in-character) moment from the IME Roleplay GTA server

forbidden.text: No botted, paid or boosted views
No negative narratives about other parties or other brands
No SARA (ethnicity, religion, race, inter-group) or insults
Content must follow the brief and stay in the campaign's context
Don't show or steer the brand toward sensitive issues
No third-party photos/videos used to demean or attack
